name: ActiveSyncDefaultAccessLevel
label: Set the default access level for new mobile devices
helpText: Sets what Exchange Online does with a mobile device it has not seen before: Allow lets it sync, Quarantine holds it until an admin allows it, Block refuses it. Devices already on a mailbox's allow or block list, or covered by a device access rule, are not affected.
executiveText: Controls whether new phones and tablets can reach company email straight away or must be approved first. Requiring approval stops unknown devices from syncing mailbox data, at the cost of a short wait for staff when they set up a new phone.
docsDescription: Sets the tenant's default ActiveSync access level, which applies to mobile devices that no allow or block list entry or device access rule covers. With **Quarantine**, a new device cannot sync until it is allowed, for example with **Allow Device** on the ActiveSync Devices report. With **Block**, new devices are refused. For more information, see [Microsoft's documentation](https://learn.microsoft.com/powershell/module/exchangepowershell/set-activesyncorganizationsettings).

accessLevel.label: Default access level for new mobile devices

options.label: Quarantine (admin must allow each new device)
